{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for confounding
print('Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_final['channel'], df_final['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rates by channel
grouped = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates:')
print(grouped)

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search)
diff = grouped['email'] - grouped['paid_search']
print(f'\nDifference (email - paid_search): {diff}')"}
